sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: AMPLIFYING/POTENT UPPER TROUGH OVER THE CANADIAN PRAIRIES WILL DIG EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD AND ULTIMATELY TAKE ON A MORE NEUTRAL TILT AS IT ADVANCES FROM SASKATCHEWAN TO NORTHERN ONTARIO BY LATE TONIGHT. ASSOCIATED PRIMARY SURFACE LOW WILL SPREAD/DEEPEN NORTHEASTWARD INTO NORTHWEST ONTARIO...WHILE A COLD FRONT ADVANCES EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD OVER THE UPPER MIDWEST/UPPER MS VALLEY...AND SOUTHWARD ACROSS THE NORTH-CENTRAL PLAINS/NORTHERN ROCKIES.

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST/UPPER GREAT LAKES
sections.text: ON THE NOSE OF A SOUTHWESTERLY LOW LEVEL JET...AND UNDER THE SOUTHERN PERIPHERAL INFLUENCE OF THE SASKATCHEWAN UPPER TROUGH...MULTIPLE TSTM CLUSTERS /PERHAPS SOME STILL STRONG TO SEVERE/ ARE LIKELY TO BE ONGOING THIS MORNING ACROSS ND/NORTHERN MN. IT IS NOT ENTIRELY CLEAR HOW THIS ACTIVITY WILL EVOLVE TOWARD MIDDAY...AND HOW IT WILL IMPACT PRE-FRONTAL DESTABILIZATION ACROSS THE LAKE SUPERIOR VICINITY THIS AFTERNOON. BUT IT DOES SEEMS PROBABLE THAT A REINVIGORATED BOUT OF STORMS WILL INCREASE BY AROUND MID AFTERNOON...ESPECIALLY ACROSS EASTERN MN INTO NORTHERN WI/UPPER MI ALONG/AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT /OR PERHAPS ALONG OUTFLOW/...AND POSSIBLY NEAR A RETREATING WARM FRONT ACROSS THE UPPER MS VALLEY. SOUTHWESTERLY MOISTURE TRANSPORT AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT WILL BOOST SURFACE DEWPOINTS THROUGH THE UPPER 60S/LOWER 70S F DURING THE DAY...WITH STRONG PRE-FRONTAL HEATING CONTRIBUTING TO MLCAPE VALUES OF 2000-4000 J/KG DURING THE AFTERNOON. GIVEN THE DEGREE OF DESTABILIZATION...WITH SOME MODAL DEPENDENCIES UPON EARLY DAY CONVECTIVE EVOLUTIONS...EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR IN EXCESS OF 40 KT WILL SUPPORT A MIXED MODE OF SUPERCELLS/LINAR BOWING SEGMENTS CAPABLE OF SEVERE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS AND A FE

sections.title: SOUTHERN APPALACHIANS/CAROLINAS
sections.text: MOIST/POTENTIALLY UNSTABLE AIRMASS WILL REMAIN ALONG A PERSISTENT/SLOW SOUTHWESTWARD SHIFTING FRONTAL BOUNDARY. TSTMS SHOULD STEADILY INCREASE IN COVERAGE/INTENSITY DURING THE AFTERNOON ESPECIALLY IN VICINITY OF THE AFOREMENTIONED FRONT. IN CONJUNCTION WITH MODESTLY ENHANCED WEST-NORTHWESTERLY FLOW ALOFT /15-20 KT AT 500 MB/...A MOIST/UNSTABLE AIRMASS...WITH POCKETS OF STRONGER HEATING YIELDING UPWARDS OF 2000-2500 J/KG SBCAPE...WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SOME ORGANIZED MULTICELLS CAPABLE OF PRIMARILY WIND DAMAGE THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING.

sections.title: NORTHERN ROCKIES/INTERMOUNTAIN WEST
sections.text: UPPER RIDGE IS FORECAST TO AMPLIFY/BUILD NORTHWARD OVER THE GREAT BASIN/NORTHERN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION TODAY...WHILE A COLD FRONT SETTLES SOUTHWARD ACROSS THE NORTHERN GREAT DIVIDE VICINITY. WHILE A SUSTAINED/ORGANIZED SEVERE THREAT IS NOT ANTICIPATED...RESIDUAL BELT OF ENHANCED MID LEVEL FLOW COUPLED WITH AMPLE PWAT WILL LIKELY YIELD A FEW STORMS CAPABLE OF HAIL/GUSTY WINDS DURING THE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING HOURS. ..GUYER/JEWELL.. 07/27/2010

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PARTS OF THE SOUTHEAST
sections.text: ...SYNOPSIS... MINIMAL OVERALL CHANGE EXPECTED THIS PERIOD AS SUBTROPICAL RIDGE PERSISTS OVER THE SOUTHEAST AND THE WLYS REMAIN CONFINED TO THE PACIFIC NW/SRN CANADA. POTENT SK SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL CONTINUE ESE TO THE MB/ONT BORDER BY EVE...AND TO LK SUPERIOR EARLY WED...AS A SERIES OF WEAKER DISTURBANCES TRACK E FROM MT/WY TO THE UPR MS VLY IN BELT OF ENHANCED FLOW IMMEDIATELY N OF THE RIDGE. SFC LOW ATTENDANT TO THE SK SYSTEM EXPECTED TO DEEPEN SUBSTANTIALLY OVER WRN/CNTRL ONT DURING THE LATTER HALF OF THE PERIOD. AT THE SAME TIME...ASSOCIATED COLD FRONT SHOULD BECOME BETTER DEFINED AND ACCELERATE S OR SSE ACROSS THE NRN PLNS...AND SE ACROSS THE UPR MS VLY. THE FRONT WILL BE PRECEDED BY WEAKER FRONTAL SURGE NOW EXTENDING FROM NW MN INTO WRN SD. THE LATTER BOUNDARY LIKELY WILL SERVE AS THE MAIN FOCUS FOR SVR STORM DEVELOPMENT THROUGH EARLY WED.

sections.title: UPR MS VLY/UPR GRT LKS
sections.text: SETUP APPEARS POTENTIALLY SUPPORTIVE OF STRONG TORNADOES OVER PARTS OF MN...WI...AND UPR MI LATER TODAY THROUGH EARLY TONIGHT...ALTHOUGH SOME UNCERTAINTY DOES EXIST REGARDING THE IMPACT OF ONGOING STORMS/STORM CLUSTERS IN MN. SMALL MCSS WITH EMBEDDED BOWS NOW IN ERN ND/NW MN APPEAR TO BE SUPPORTED NOT ONLY BY PERSISTENT WAA/MOISTURE INFLOW BUT ALSO BY ASCENT WITH IMPULSES IN AFOREMENTIONED SRN STREAM JET. THE STORMS COULD PERSIST THROUGH AT LEAST MIDDAY...EXTENDING THREAT FOR ISOLD DMGG WIND GUSTS AND POSSIBLY MARGINALLY SVR HAIL E ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF NRN/CNTRL MN AND NW WI. SATELLITE AND SFC DATA DO...HOWEVER...SUGGEST THAT AMPLE LOW LVL DESTABILIZATION WILL OCCUR IN STRENGTHENING/CONFLUENT SWLY LOW LVL FLOW TO SUPPORT NEW STORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG/AHEAD OF LEAD COLD FRONT OVER CNTRL MN...NWRN WI...AND WRN UPR MI BY MID TO LATE AFTN. DEVELOPMENT ALSO COULD FOCUS ALONG ANY OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES LEFT OVER REGION. WITH SFC DEWPOINTS RISING INTO THE LWR 70S F BENEATH NARROWING PLUME OF EML THAT WILL MAINTAIN STEEP MID LVL LAPSE RATES... SBCAPE SHOULD INCREASE TO AOA 3000 J/KG. COUPLED WITH 40-45 KT WLY MID LVL FLOW ATOP 30+ KT SWLY 850 MB JET...SETUP SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS

sections.title: TN VLY/SRN APPALACHIANS/CAROLINAS
sections.text: MOIST/POTENTIALLY UNSTABLE AIR WILL PERSIST INVOF REMNANT FRONT STALLED ROUGHLY NW/SE ACROSS REGION. TSTM COVERAGE/INTENSITY SHOULD INCREASE NEAR THE BOUNDARY THROUGH THE AFTN. COUPLED WITH BELT OF MODEST WNW FLOW ALOFT /15-20 KT AT 500 MB/...POCKETS OF 2000-2500 J/KG SBCAPE MAY SUPPORT SOME MULTICELL CLUSTERS CAPABLE OF LOCALLY DMGG WIND THROUGH EARLY EVE.

sections.title: NRN RCKYS/INTERMOUNTAIN REGION
sections.text: UPR RIDGE EXPECTED TO BUILD N ACROSS THE GRT BASIN/NRN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION TODAY...WHILE WRN PART OF COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH SK/MB UPR TROUGH SETTLES S ACROSS PARTS OF ID/MT. LOW LVL MOISTURE SPREADING WWD INTO REGION IN WAKE OF FRONT... PRESENCE OF 30 KT SW TO WSWLY FLOW ON NRN FRINGE OF RIDGE...AND TERRAIN UPLIFT MAY SUPPORT A FEW SMALL CLUSTERS OF STORMS WITH GUSTY WINDS AND MARGINALLY SVR HAIL THIS AFTN AND EARLY EVE. ..CORFIDI/STOPPKOTTE.. 07/27/2010

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PARTS OF THE SOUTHEAST
sections.text: ...UPR MS VLY/UPR GRT LAKES... AS A VERY MOIST AND UNSTABLE AIR MASS CONTINUES TO SURGE NEWD ACROSS MN/WI INTO UPR GRT LAKES THIS AM...CONDITIONS STILL ON TRACK FOR A POTENTIALLY VERY ACTIVE SEVERE THUNDERSTORM EVENT. WITH THE STRONG TROUGH NOW SCENTRAL CANADA CONTINUING TO TRANSLATE EWD...WIND PROFILES IN SUPPORT OF ORGANIZED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS INCLUDING SUPERCELLS WILL BE IN PLACE THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING FROM CENTRAL/NRN MN EWD ACROSS NRN WI INTO THE UP OF MICHIGAN. CONSIDERED AN UPGRADE TO MDT ACROSS NRN WI INTO THE UP OF MI FOR LATER THIS AFTERNOON AS THE STRONG WIND MAX WITH THE UPR TROUGH ROTATES ACROSS...HOWEVER THERE IS STILL A CONCERN AS TO HOW THE ONGOING ELEVATED STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL IMPACT THE DESTABILIZATION PROCESS NWD INTO WI. FOCUS FOR SURFACE BASED SEVERE DEVELOPMENT...I.E. POTENTIAL FOR TORNADIC SUPERCELLS...DEPENDENT ON THE BOUNDARIES THAT WILL EVOLVE FROM THIS MORNING CONVECTION. GIVEN MLCAPES UPWARDS TO 4000 J/KG IN THE WARM SECTOR AND AT LEAST 30-40 KT OF SHEAR...THERE IS THE POTENTIAL FOR STRONG TORNADOES WITH ANY SUPERCELL THAT DEVELOPS BY LATER THIS AFTERNOON. sections.title: NORTH-CENTRAL PLAINS/UPPER MIDWEST TO UPPER GREAT LAKES
sections.text: SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS STRONG/SEVERE TSTMS AMID AN EVOLVING CONVECTIVE LINE WILL CONTINUE THROUGH THE MID/LATE EVENING HOURS...ALONG/AHEAD OF A SOUTHEAST MOVING COLD FRONT FROM THE U.P. OF MI AND NORTHERN/CENTRAL WI TO SOUTHERN MN AND SOUTHEAST SD/NORTHERN NEB. AHEAD OF THE QLCS...THE 00Z OBSERVED RAOB FROM MINNEAPOLIS SAMPLED A VERY UNSTABLE/RELATIVELY STEEP LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT WITH NEARLY 4000 J/KG OF MLCAPE...AMID STRONG/SEMI-UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND PROFILES WITH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR AROUND 40 KT. ASIDE FROM LINGERING BOUTS OF SEVERE HAIL...DECIDEDLY LINEAR MODAL EVOLUTION/WITH SMALL BOWS...AMID COLD-FRONTAL FORCING/LARGELY UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND PROFILES...WILL FAVOR A DAMAGING WIND RISK THE REMAINDER OF THE EVENING. WITH THAT SAID...THE MOST FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT FOR A TORNADO /ESPECIALLY WITH ANY SEMI-DISCRETE STORMS/ YET THIS EVENING WOULD APPEAR TO BE ACROSS NORTHERN WI/THE U.P. OF MI...IN VICINITY OF A WARM FRONT AND AHEAD OF A FRONTAL WAVE/SUBTLE SURFACE LOW WHERE SURFACE PRESSURE FALLS ARE STILL EVIDENT EARLY THIS EVENING.

sections.title: SOUTHEAST STATES/CAROLINAS
sections.text: POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WINDS WILL STEADILY WANE THIS EVENING ACROSS THE REGION. THE PRIMARY SHORT TERM SEVERE THREAT WILL REMAIN ACROSS COASTAL SC/GA VICINITY IN ASSOCIATION WITH A SOUTH-SOUTHEASTWARD PROPAGATING LINEAR CLUSTER...WITH THE 00Z CHARLESTON OBSERVED RAOB INDICATIVE OF MLCAPE IN EXCESS OF 3000 J/KG.

sections.title: NORTHERN ROCKIES/INTERMOUNTAIN REGION
sections.text: A FEW STRONG/SEVERE TSTMS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE MAINLY THROUGH EARLY/MID EVENING ACROSS A BROAD EXPANSE OF THE WEST AMID ENHANCED FLOW ALOFT/HIGH PWAT. ANY SUCH SEVERE THREAT WILL LIKELY REMAIN ISOLATED/MARGINAL IN NATURE. THIS INCLUDES POTENTIAL FOR SOME SUPERCELLS ACROSS SOUTHERN MT OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS...IN CONJUNCTION WITH STRONGLY VEERED WIND PROFILES AND A RELATIVELY MOIST/UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT. ..GUYER.. 07/28/2010
